definitions.explanation: Any medication taken to treat stomach problems such as indigestion, heartburn, nausea, or stomach pain.

examples.japanese: {胃薬|いぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
{食|た}べすぎて⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{胃薬|いぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きて。
examples.english: I ate too much and my stomach hurts, so go buy me some stomach medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{念|ねん}のため→念のため：16746_nennotame⟧{胃薬|いぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I travel, I make sure to bring stomach medicine just in case.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧ (stomach) + ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (medicine), with sequential voicing (rendaku) producing ぐすり. A practical everyday word known to all Japanese speakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃薬|いぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take stomach medicine
- {胃薬|いぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy stomach medicine
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{胃薬|いぐすり}: over-the-counter stomach medicine

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{頭痛薬|ずつうやく}→頭痛薬：09711_zutsuuyaku⟧: headache medicine
- ⟦{風邪薬|かぜぐすり}→風邪薬：09712_kazegusuri⟧: cold medicine
- {胃腸薬|いちょうやく}: gastrointestinal medicine — a broader category that includes intestinal remedies
